title: Nullivance Propositional Logic: Lean 4 formalization and manuscript
description:
Machine-checked development of nullivance propositional logic (NPL), a two-channel logic valued in the unit square [0,1]^2 with a harmonization (bilattice consensus) connective and a threshold-indexed family of signed consequence relations. The Lean 4 library (Nullivance/) verifies: the continuous two-channel semantics and its bilattice structure; the exact threshold projection onto the four-valued matrix; a four-signed analytic tableau calculus with soundness and completeness (over the matrix and, by the projection, over the continuous semantics); paraconsistency, non-definability of the consensus connective from the FDE fragment, incompleteness of the source natural-deduction system; a generative tier deriving truth-objects from (intensity, structure) channel pairs; and a complete finite-domain quantified layer (function-free syntax with crisp equality over finite nonempty domains, exact threshold projection, and a machine-checked semantic completeness theorem for a macro-free extensional tableau calculus). The accompanying manuscript (papers/npl-core/) mirrors the development; results marked [L] are verified sorry-free.

Toolchain: Lean 4 v4.32.0-rc1, mathlib (pinned). Build: cd Nullivance && lake exe cache get && lake build.
notes: Lean toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.32.0-rc1; mathlib pinned at rev 8f5331973a3e2b3cc5fd307208f456ccd6d3b467. The library builds sorry-free; see ARTIFACT.md for the correspondence between manuscript results and Lean declarations.
